'''Sera''' is a ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]]. She is the strongest of the Tuon's ''damane'' and as proud as a ''[[sul'dam]]''.{{ref/book|9|14}}

== Appearance ==
She has tightly curled black hair with red ribbons.{{ref/book|9|14}}

== Activities ==
She is one of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s personal ''damane'' who are part of the [[Corenne]].
